articles.title: India must cut critical materials dependence to secure tech ambitions, says Vaishnaw
articles.description: India’s semiconductor ambitions face a supply-chain challenge as key manufacturing inputs remain concentrated in a small number of countries. Electronics Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw says the country must build domestic capabilities in critical materials, strengthen applied research and develop a broader industrial ecosystem while remaining integrated with global technology and manufacturing networks.
